implementation_and_policy_boundary.authority_fence: Authority commands retain the exclusive tenant fence while relation reads hold it shared. The existing 500 ms source-authority wait limit is not increased; a concurrent command may still be busy. Custody grants no wait-time change or authority bypass.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.busy_signal: Only source-authority enroll/grant/revoke map SQLSTATE 55P03 and 57014 to SourceAuthorityBusy after their transaction exits; CLI reports failed/source_authority_busy. This is an observable failure-reason change, not successful enrollment, grant, revocation or disclosure. The database cause stays internal and does not authorize diagnostic leakage.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.collector_authority: The new helper is private with PUBLIC execution revoked and no grant added. CREATE OR REPLACE preserves the kernel object authority; no new reader executable function or query-reader object is introduced. Actual installed privileges still require ordinary runtime qualification.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.context_cleanup: Only the stale-context DELETE block in the M0006 begin_authorization_context function text is replaced. Its credential, membership, pairing and refusal checks, context insertion/return and declared security header remain byte-identical outside that block. The caller transaction previous context is removed immediately. Other removable context rows are collected using the same removal reasons with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.matched_conditions: Use the same implementation and schema 40 baseline for both evaluation peers. No peer receives extra authority, retries, time, source representations or evidence credit because cleanup contention improved. Do not combine pre-change and post-change primary outcomes as a matched comparison.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.replay_and_grading: An identical idempotent source-authority retry is permitted by the product only once the preceding transaction is conclusively rolled back or settled. This does not add evaluation attempts, refund/reset budgets, rerun uncertain computation or alter frozen retry/stop rules. Retain actual busy outcomes, time and charges. Safely settled required-operation failure follows F1; genuine ownership/accounting uncertainty remains F2; authority/evidence breaches remain F3. Missing required evidence or a failed grant/revocation remains unmet unless the frozen case specifically expects that refusal.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.scope_preserved: The approved packet, lifecycle dependency, AM-5/12(a) scope, raw-source limits, source-text rules, relation coverage, receipt obligations, retained results, evaluation profiles, thresholds, grading and seen/unseen separation remain unchanged.
implementation_and_policy_boundary.snapshot_isolation: The collection-only subtransaction may roll back a serialization failure, leaving collection for another call. This does not suppress authority failures, resurrect old contexts, weaken backend/transaction binding or extend result/source authority. It is not a blanket retry or success guarantee for other operations.
